decisions.title: Which species may be a starter
decisions.notes: Canonical species identity comes from the Pokédex (1,149 rows); which subset is offered is pure campaign policy (starter pool). GM memory currently owns this entirely.

decisions.title: Starter level
decisions.notes: Level bounds 1-100 with the canonical experience chart; the default starter level is campaign policy, not a universal PTU constant in app data.

decisions.title: Species forms
decisions.notes: Forms are separate Pokédex rows (e.g. 'Rotom Heat', 'Shaymin Sky Forme'). There is no structured form-family linkage; selection must resolve to exactly one canonical row and never fabricate forms from name strings.

dataDefect.requiredAction: Starter pools must reference exact Pokédex row identities. If a campaign wants form choice at creation, the pool lists each form row explicitly; no runtime form inference. No rules.json change required, but catalog compilation (P9-015) must freeze row identity hashes.

decisions.title: Species base stats
decisions.notes: Six-stat base blocks per row (spatk/spdef key spelling); sparse legacy rows exist and must fail closed if selected into a pool.

decisions.title: Added stat points (Level + 10)
decisions.notes: Structured formula already used by runtime advancement.

decisions.title: Base Relations ordering for added stats
decisions.notes: Rule text plus existing runtime violation detection; onboarding validation reuses the same derivation rather than re-deriving from prose.

decisions.title: Nature choice and stat effects
decisions.notes: 37 natures with plus/minus stat mappings are app-owned runtime authority already consumed by sheets.

decisions.title: Starting Ability (Basic tier at Level 1)
decisions.notes: Tiered species ability sets plus milestone ordinals (L1 basic, L20 basic/advanced, L40 any). 130 Pokédex rows lack Basic Abilities and must fail closed if pooled.

decisions.title: Starting Moves from the level-up list
decisions.notes: Level-gated candidates, six active Move maximum, replacement rules; TM/tutor additions at creation are campaign policy.

decisions.title: Pokémon skill dice
decisions.notes: Species default skill dice strings; overrides after creation belong to advancement/edges, not onboarding.

decisions.title: Capabilities, size, weight, movement
decisions.notes: Structured movement values plus named capability list with canonical capability definitions.

decisions.title: Gender
decisions.notes: Species gender ratios; genderless species must not collect a gender choice.

decisions.title: Starting Loyalty
decisions.notes: Loyalty is prose-only; the sheet stores a numeric loyalty field but no structured source states the starting value for a new starter.

dataDefect.requiredAction: Add characterCreationMechanics.startingLoyalty default to data/reference/rules.json through a reviewed, source-hash-bound migration before P9-047; policy may expose a bounded override.

decisions.title: Tutor Points at creation (1 + floor(level/5))
decisions.notes: Existing runtime formula backed by the rule text.

decisions.title: Starter held item
decisions.notes: Whether starters begin with held items is policy; item identity and custody use Plan 8 authority.

decisions.title: Team membership and the six-Pokémon limit
decisions.notes: Team limit constant exists client-side only; onboarding commit must enforce it server-side (P9-048, P9-057).

decisions.title: Ownership and acquisition provenance
decisions.notes: Species acquisition history exists for capture/breeding; onboarding must record an explicit 'onboarding' acquisition source rather than leaving starters provenance-free.

decisions.title: Nickname, shiny flag, portrait, caught-ball metadata
decisions.notes: Non-mechanical presentation bounded by sheet schema; ball identity references items.json when set.

decisions.title: Experience total for the chosen level
decisions.notes: Committed starters must carry the canonical experience floor for their level so later settlement math is coherent.
